evidence: In the 3D top view every body (C1/C5 left of U1, R5/D1 right of U1, passives above SW1/SW2) shows visible board surface between itself and its neighbors, with no touching or stacked parts.

J1 sits at the left edge with its opening facing outward and clear board in front of it (confirmed in 3d_iso_back), and J2 is a vertical pin header at the right edge with unobstructed top access and nothing between either connector and its edge.

The two repeated button subcircuits are not identical: SW2's passives (R3 offset higher and to the left) do not mirror SW1's arrangement, C2 floats alone between the groups, and R3/R1/R4/R2 do not form a single aligned row, giving a ragged scattered look in the 2D view.

C1 and C5 designators overlap each other directly, the U1 bottom pad row labels (15-26) collapse into one illegible garbled string of overlapping text, and R5/D1 labels nearly collide right of the module.

Large dead regions occupy most of the right half (only J2), the left side, and both bottom corners while all circuitry crowds the center, and J2 is stranded a full board-width from U1 with long ratsnest lines crossing the empty area.
